Class CobolSql.SelectBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.CobolSql.SelectBuilder
Enclosing class:
CobolSql
public final class CobolSql.SelectBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for SELECT ... INTO (single-row query).

Maps directly to COBOL's: 

EXEC SQL
    SELECT col1, col2 INTO :HOST1, :HOST2
    FROM table WHERE key = :HOST3
END-EXEC
